analysis_protocol.reason: Calendar split for descriptive stability checks, selected before computing this pilot outcomes; existing prices and calls are historical and not an untouched evaluation set.

protocol.interpretation: Descriptive stored-call 24 elapsed-hour experiment; not an untouched holdout, production execution rule, or calibrated threshold.

interpretation: Recorded Gold 24H directions compared with OANDA next-minute-after-storage to 24 elapsed-hour endpoints. Storage is not authenticated dashboard publication. Endpoint results do not validate the trade path.

nonoverlapping_schedule.selection: Greedy earliest source decision, retaining unavailable outcomes; skip decisions before retained horizon. This does not prove independent market trials.

path.interpretation: Interior gaps remain unclassified; endpoint accuracy does not establish target/stop sequencing.

limitations: Cohort checks are descriptive and were added after the initial aggregate was observed; they are not new holdout trials.
Constant-direction baselines use the same CORRECT/WRONG subset; flats, no-calls and rejected calls are excluded from both.
Earliest-snapshot and nonoverlap selection occur before outcome filtering; rejected selected calls are not replaced.

protocol.interpretation: Descriptive stored-call 24 elapsed-hour experiment; not an untouched holdout, production execution rule, or calibrated threshold.

limitations: Caller chooses the split; this tool cannot establish that validation data was previously unseen.
Overlapping calls within a partition may be dependent; sample counts are not independent trial counts.
All ten factors and 45 pairs are descriptive comparisons, not significance-tested edge or executable profits.
Feature and candle provenance is supplied metadata, not independently authenticated.
Endpoint-only coverage, when explicitly selected, does not validate the intervening path.
